title: SREGym: A Live Benchmark for AI SRE Agents with High-Fidelity Failure Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2605.07161v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI agents are increasingly used to diagnose and mitigate failures in production systems, known as agentic Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). Current SRE benchmarks are limited to oversimplistic SRE tasks and are unfortunately hard to extend due to bespoke designs. We present SREGym, a high-fidelity benchmark for SRE agents. SREGym exposes a live system environment built atop real-world cloud-native system stacks, where high-fidelity failure scenarios are simulated through fault injectors. SREGym models the complexity of production environments by simulating (1) a wide range of faults at different layers, (2) various ambient noises, and (3) diverse failure modes such as metastable failures and correlated failures. SREGym is architected as a modular, extensible framework that orchestrates fault and noise injectors across stacks. SREGym currently includes 90 realistic, challenging SRE problems. We use SREGym to evaluate frontier agents

translated_title: SREGym：面向AI SRE智能体的具有高保真故障场景的实时基准测试
translated_abstract: AI智能体正越来越多地被用于诊断和缓解生产系统中的故障，这被称为智能体化站点可靠性工程。当前的SRE基准测试局限于过于简化的SRE任务，并且由于其定制化设计而难以扩展。我们提出了SREGym，这是一个面向SRE智能体的高保真基准测试。SREGym提供了一个构建在真实世界云原生系统栈之上的实时系统环境，通过故障注入器模拟高保真的故障场景。SREGym通过模拟以下内容来建模生产环境的复杂性：（1）不同层次的多种故障，（2）各种环境噪声，（3）多样化的故障模式，如亚稳态故障和关联故障。SREGym被架构为一个模块化、可扩展的框架，能够跨系统栈编排故障和噪声注入器。SREGym目前包含90个真实且具有挑战性的SRE问题。我们使用SREGym来评估前沿智能体。
tldr: SREGym是一个构建在真实云原生系统栈之上的高保真、模块化可扩展的实时基准测试，通过模拟多层次故障、环境噪声及亚稳态等多样化故障模式来评估AI SRE智能体，包含90个真实且具有挑战性的SRE问题。
en_tdlr: SREGym is a high-fidelity, modular, and extensible live benchmark built atop real-world cloud-native stacks that evaluates AI SRE agents by simulating multi-layer faults, ambient noises, and diverse failure modes such as metastable failures, featuring 90 realistic and challenging SRE problems.
